parts.note: usually means the social elite, but read literally it is people who get to the top of peaks

explanation.walkthrough: 'Top people' suggests the upper class; the question mark says take it literally: climbers who reach summits.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbers of high peaks are the people who end up on the very top of mountains.

clue.text: Many a fool, given time, creates friction

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, standing for a large number
an ass is a fool
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone foolish, given long enough, ends up causing quarrels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Friction' here is the physical rubbing of the body, not discord between people.
explanation.definitionFit: A masseur works by rubbing, and friction is an old word for rubbing the skin.

parts.note: ED is short for editor, the crossword's usual journalist

explanation.surface: A US reporter has been exploited.
explanation.definitionFit: To be exploited is to be put to use by someone else.

parts.note: reads as a tidy haircut, but the order is a religious order of monks and their shaved crown

explanation.walkthrough: 'In order' seems to mean neat; it is a monastic order, whose members traditionally shaved the top of the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Monks and friars shaved the crown of the head as a sign of religious life.

indicators.note: the insect holds the parking letter inside it, keeping it within

parts.note: an insect has six legs, so it is a six-footer
P is the standard abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: A tall person holding a parking ticket to be examined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Six-footer' looks like a tall person; it is a creature with six feet, an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine something closely is to check it.

clue.text: Drink up before noon and dash

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for the drink is read from bottom to top

parts.note: ale is a drink

explanation.surface: Knock back a drink before midday and rush off.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash as a noun means flair or verve, a sense of style and energy.

clue.text: The cowboy sprinted and caught the girl

parts.note: ran means sprinted
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
her is the pronoun for a girl

explanation.surface: A cowboy ran off and seized the girl, like a Western plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranch owner in the American West is a cattleman, the boss of the cowboys.

clue.text: A gift where the fighting man is involved

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A present is handed over wherever the soldier is caught up in things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is involved' shuffles all the letters of A GIFT WHERE THE.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer in one of the lighter weight divisions is a fighting man.

clue.text: Not what's meant by the curate!

definitions.text: Not what's meant by the curate!

parts.words: Not what's meant by the curate!
parts.note: a curate is a clerk in holy orders; the clue points to a different sort of clerk, one bound by articles of training

explanation.walkthrough: A clergyman was formally a clerk in holy orders; this clerk is instead a trainee solicitor bound by articles, a former British legal apprenticeship.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee solicitor bound by a training contract is a clerk, but not a clerical one like a curate.

parts.note: Easter is a Christian feast day
N is short for named

explanation.surface: An Asian festival day is given its name.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental and its synonym both describe things from the East.

clue.text: Musician taking rest in a break

indicators.note: break means smash apart, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician has a rest during an interval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break' scrambles REST IN A. Sir John Stainer was a Victorian English composer and organist.
explanation.definitionFit: Stainer was a composer of church music, so a musician.

definitions.meaning: a drop from the eye when crying
a rent is a rip in cloth

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a droplet shed when weeping; the other is a rip in fabric, pronounced differently.

indicators.note: stupid suggests muddled thinking, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A foolish quarrel between men grew furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To be furious and seething is to rage.

clue.text: A man from the East may make a hit

indicators.note: the letters of these words may be made into a different word when reordered

explanation.surface: An Asian man could score a success.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Thailand in South-East Asia is an Easterner.

definitions.meaning: a tiny measure of liquid in old apothecaries' units
a musical note of two beats, a half note

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names the smallest apothecaries' fluid measure and a half note in music.

clue.text: Get together in the sun-it encourages sociability

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Gathering in the sunshine makes people friendlier.
explanation.definitionFit: To come together is to join or combine.

clue.text: Time to turn in before he's anti-social

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

indicators.note: turn in tells us the word time is turned about into a new order

parts.note: the fodder for the anagram

explanation.surface: Going to bed early because he doesn't like company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To turn in' sounds like going to bed, but it signals the anagram of 'Time'; 'he's anti-social' describes a recluse.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit, a recluse who shuns company, is someone unsociable.

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten
DR is short for doctor
IL is a Roman numeral form for 49, one before fifty

explanation.surface: A cryptic message about a doctor and a number spins round.
explanation.walkthrough: IL for 49 is not standard Roman notation (XLIX), but setters use it.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant's curling climbing shoot twists round supports.

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Turning up in a fresh outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: To be sporting a garment is to have it on.

clue.text: Everyone for example turning over gold briskly

parts.note: all means everyone

indicators.note: turning over means the heraldic word for gold is written backwards

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Everybody, as an instance, quickly flips gold.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is gold in heraldry; 'turning over' makes it RO.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian tempo marking tells players to go fast and lively.

indicators.note: alterations means changes, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Undergo changes in return for a fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alterations' rearranges UNDERGO. The answer is an archaic word for a reward.
explanation.definitionFit: An old literary word for a reward or recompense.

clue.text: Treatment of social worker by a section of the police

parts.note: an ant is a social insect and a worker
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: A welfare officer being dealt with by detectives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' looks like a care professional but is the insect. CID is the detective branch of British police.
explanation.definitionFit: A medicine for indigestion is a remedy, a treatment.

parts.note: describes a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of another

explanation.definitionFit: A word play made by rearranging letters is exactly a re-sorting of them.

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
pious means devout, very good in a religious way

explanation.surface: Plentiful, solid and excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Plentiful in quantity, ample.

clue.text: A piece of land that's about a quarter lake

parts.note: that's expands to that is, giving is

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the quarter and lake letters run backwards

parts.note: E for east is one of the four compass quarters

explanation.surface: A patch of ground that is roughly one-quarter water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' turns E plus L into LE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small island is a piece of land in water.

indicators.note: within means the Spanish article sits inside the word for a day

parts.note: a day lasts 24 hours
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Detain the Spaniards inside one day.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrest progress is to hold it up or slow it.

clue.text: Work with a trainee to produce a gem

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
L is for learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: Collaborate with an apprentice to create a jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: A milky iridescent stone is a precious gem.

indicators.note: received by means the king's letter is taken in by the word for poor

parts.note: bad means poor in quality
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A monarch gives an audience to a penniless versifier.
explanation.definitionFit: A bard is a traditional term for a poet, Shakespeare being the Bard.

clue.text: Don't know your name but we'll soon see

definitions.meaning: short for anonymous, of an unnamed author
an old word meaning shortly, in a while

explanation.definitionFit: It abbreviates the word for an unnamed writer and is also archaic for presently.

definitions.meaning: looking exhausted and gaunt from worry
H. Rider ..., Victorian novelist of King Solomon's Mines

explanation.definitionFit: The word means gaunt and worn out, and is also the surname of an adventure novelist.

parts.note: ran means hurried

indicators.note: begun means only the opening of the word courtship is used, its later letters dropped

explanation.surface: A rushed romance starting out in bitterness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Begun' keeps only the first four letters of COURTSHIP.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter lasting resentment is animosity.

clue.text: As women do, one arranges some flowers

indicators.note: arranges means puts in a new order, as with blooms in a vase

explanation.surface: Like women, a person does a flower arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodland spring plants with white blooms are flowers.
